modeReason: Three stories reach or exceed the relevance threshold of 8: AI agents being locked out across much of the web, a retailer using AI to flag union organizing risk in warehouses, and a novel "distillation attack" breach exposing a coding agent's API keys.
phrase: AI agents promise to book your dinner and clear your inbox. One major retailer uses a similar AI to watch warehouse workers for signs of a union.
phraseAlternatives: Everyone is building an AI agent that can book your dinner or clean your inbox. One retailer uses a similar AI to flag warehouse workers who might want a union.
The web is closing its doors to AI agents built to browse and shop for you. Elsewhere, a similar AI watches warehouse workers for signs of a union.
Help here, watching there: the AI built to run your errands has a cousin that watches warehouse workers for signs of organizing a union.

brief.concept: A small robot agent knocks hopefully on a door shaped like a webpage marked CLOSED, while in a second scene a warehouse worker holding a union flyer looks up at a ceiling-mounted robot sensor watching them.
brief.metaphor: The same helpful AI wears two faces: locked out when it tries to be useful on the open web, welcomed in when it is put to work watching people.

cast.who: a small robot agent knocking on a plain door marked CLOSED
a closed sign hanging above the doorway
a warehouse worker holding a small flyer, glancing upward
a ceiling-mounted robot sensor with one round watchful eye pointed down

brief.composition: Two simple vignettes side by side, separated by a thin vertical line. Left: a small robot raises one hand to knock on a plain door with a CLOSED sign above it. Right: a warehouse worker stands in an aisle, holding a small flyer, looking up at an overhead sensor robot whose single round eye points straight down at them. No other text in the image.
brief.alt: A split illustration. On the left, a small robot knocks on a plain door marked CLOSED. On the right, a warehouse worker holding a flyer looks up at a round-eyed sensor mounted on the ceiling, watching them.
